selection.authorization: The current request authorizes a public extract of already-public citations and public Registry guidance.
selection.enumeration: Exactly the 13 work records listed here; selected for concrete visualization decisions rather than exhaustive coverage.
selection.uniqueWorkRule: One stable id per selected work. D3 sections count as one documentation work; Wilke's inspected chapter counts within one book. Distinct practitioner commentary and the empirical study it cites remain separate works, not independent confirmations.
selection.membershipRule: Topics are explicit editorial classifications. A work contributes once to each assigned topic and may contribute to several topics.
selection.coverage: Complete for the enumerated subset only. Coverage of the wider bibliography, literature, Registry, and private workspace is unspecified.
selection.inspectionBoundary: Inspection covers the named sections and scopes, not every cited work in those sources. Registry content was read through its connector under confirmed public Registry ancestry; its public route is retained without a claim of anonymous browser access.
exclusions: Private workspace pages, names, locators, search-result totals, and operating material.
Public works that were not selected and inspected for this extract; this is not a systematic literature review.
Heer and Bostock's graphical-perception paper, whose attempted source retrieval was unavailable in this selection pass.
Uninspected chapters and document sections; multiple URLs for an included work do not add works.
Application frequency, adoption, measured impact, evidence-quality scores, and current workspace counts.
Source article full text, page dumps, connector metadata, and synthetic example data from the Registry.

records.title: Declutter and Focus: Empirically Evaluating Design Guidelines for Effective Data Communication
records.creditedTo: Kiran Ajani; Elsie Lee; Cindy Xiong; Cole Nussbaumer Knaflic; William Kemper; Steven Franconeri
records.evidenceStanding: Controlled graph-design experiment; this extract inspected the conference abstract. It supports changes in subjective ratings and recall under the reported task conditions.
records.supportedConsequence: Use selective emphasis for a stated reading; the study reports changes in subjective ratings and recalled highlighted patterns under its task conditions.
records.transferBoundary: General comprehension, correctness, trust, and any universal rule about shadows remain unestablished.

records.title: Beyond Bar and Line Graphs: Time for a New Data Presentation Paradigm
records.creditedTo: Tracey L. Weissgerber; Natasa M. Milic; Stacey J. Winham; Vesna D. Garovic
records.evidenceStanding: Systematic review of 703 physiology articles from a defined 2014 journal/time frame, accompanied by worked data-display examples.
records.supportedConsequence: Retain observations or paired changes when distribution and within-unit dependence matter; the same mean and error summary can conceal different data structures.
records.transferBoundary: That publication sample is distinct from this repository and workspace. Continuous-data summaries and categorical count bars have different meanings.

records.title: A Nested Model for Visualization Design and Validation
records.evidenceStanding: Author's abstract of a conceptual design and validation framework.
records.supportedConsequence: Separate the domain question, data/task abstraction, encoding/interaction, and algorithm; choose observations that address the level of the decision.
records.transferBoundary: The framework structures validation; implementation validity and measured usability require observations of the receiving implementation.

records.title: Complex Images
records.version: Living Images Tutorial; page updated 2026-04-08; inspected 2026-10-04
records.evidenceStanding: Official accessibility tutorial with short and extended description examples.
records.supportedConsequence: Pair a complex figure with concise identification and a recoverable account of its meaningful values and relationships, retaining useful table structure.
records.transferBoundary: A text companion is one design measure; complete accessibility and conformance require broader evaluation of the receiving experience.

records.title: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) 2: Conformance
records.version: SVG 2, W3C Candidate Recommendation, 2018-10-04; conformance chapter inspected 2026-10-04
records.evidenceStanding: SVG specification provisions define document and image processing modes.
records.supportedConsequence: Choose image delivery for static content and a separately governed document or inline representation when scripting or interaction is required.
records.transferBoundary: Each embedding mode and receiving interface requires its own capability check.

records.title: D3 documentation: scales and data joins
records.evidenceStanding: Official API documentation; the two inspected sections form one documentation-work record.
records.supportedConsequence: Keep data-to-position mapping explicit and use stable keys for record-to-element correspondence when a view updates.
records.transferBoundary: Retained selection, keyboard behavior, and cross-view consistency require observations of the receiving implementation.

records.title: Matplotlib documentation: matplotlib.pyplot.savefig
records.evidenceStanding: Official export API documentation, limited here to the savefig entry.
records.supportedConsequence: Specify the output format and resolution deliberately and account for backend-dependent metadata when handing off a figure.
records.transferBoundary: Final-size legibility, embedded-font behavior, and receiving-PDF accessibility require observations of the exported artifact.

records.title: Data over time: Line chart
records.evidenceStanding: Official practice guidance for line-chart construction and alternatives.
records.supportedConsequence: Expose irregular observations with markers, preserve gaps for missing regular observations, and use steps for values held between discrete changes.
records.transferBoundary: Interpolation and time-series modeling require dataset-specific justification.

records.title: Fundamentals of Data Visualization
records.version: Online book, chapter 3: Coordinate systems and axes; inspected 2026-10-04
records.evidenceStanding: Author-written explanatory book; this extract inspected one chapter and counts the book once.
records.supportedConsequence: Choose additive or multiplicative distance to match the question; distinguish raw-value log-axis ticks from labels for already transformed values.
records.transferBoundary: Coordinate examples supply design reasoning; universal audience comprehension remains unestablished. Ordinary log axes require positive values.

records.title: Bullet Graph Design Specification
records.supportedConsequence: Compare one measure with supplied reference values on a common scale; use zero-based bars or a point mark when a restricted range is necessary.
records.transferBoundary: Domain definitions supply targets and qualitative ranges; a universal performance advantage remains unestablished.

records.title: The Role of Software and the Importance of Thoughtful Defaults
records.evidenceStanding: Practitioner essay and chart examples about software defaults.
records.supportedConsequence: Choose defaults that fit data and reading, including zero-based bars, point marks for restricted ranges, and subdued supporting guides.
records.transferBoundary: These recommendations carry practitioner reasoning; an experimental ranking or universal axis-and-guide rule would require separate evidence.

records.title: two tips for better graphs
records.version: Public article inspected 2026-10-04; visible date April 27 leaves year unspecified
records.evidenceStanding: Practitioner explanation linked to the separately counted Ajani et al. study.
records.supportedConsequence: Reduce distracting detail and use limited contrast to direct an explanatory reading while retaining comparison context.
records.transferBoundary: The pair shares source lineage and contributes one line of empirical support; independent corroboration requires a separate work.

records.title: Visualization Fidelity Atlas: Data Shape to Cognitive Move to Visual Form
records.version: Version 0.1.0; public Registry content last edited 2026-09-30
records.evidenceStanding: Public Registry method synthesis; connector content confirms the public-route property and Registry ancestry.
records.supportedConsequence: Choose from the reader's operation, data shape, audience/stakes, uncertainty, and companion need; distinguish production commitment from evidence strength.
records.transferBoundary: The Registry guidance and its synthetic examples establish a method. Dataset validity, empirical impact, and deployment require their own evidence; public-route rendering remains unchecked.
